items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The first was Johnny King, he was of Mobile of course

ctx.x: Now the different piano players that we had from time to time from now. About stuff
The first was Johnny King, he was of Mobile of course, then Clarence Williams, George Thomas, Maroney Jones, which is Richard Jones of course, Buddy Christian.
Yes, he's in New York, I think he may be dead now I believe.
